per_instance.R.01:Product: An item the business buys, stocks and sells.
per_instance.R.01:Supplier: A company the business buys from.
per_instance.R.01:Customer account: A company or person the business sells to.
per_instance.R.01:Purchase order: An order placed with a supplier to buy stock.
per_instance.R.01:Purchase order line: One product and quantity on a purchase order.
per_instance.R.01:Sales order: An order from a customer to be picked, shipped and invoiced.
per_instance.R.01:Sales order line: One product and quantity on a sales order.
per_instance.R.01:Stock adjustment: A manual correction to a product's stock level, with a reason.

FL.01:Purchase order lifecycle.action: creating a purchase order (starts in Draft)

per_instance.FL.08:Purchase order lifecycle: On Received, each line's Quantity is added to its Product's Stock on hand.

FL.01:Sales order lifecycle.action: creating a sales order (starts in Draft)

per_instance.FL.08:Sales order lifecycle: On Shipped, each line's Quantity is subtracted from its Product's Stock on hand.

N.01:Low stock alert.event: a Product's Stock on hand falls to or below its Reorder point

per_instance.N.04:Low stock alert: This product is running out — raise a purchase order.

N.01:Order shipped.event: a sales order moves to Shipped

per_instance.N.04:Order shipped: The customer's order has left — tell them if they ask.
per_instance.RP.01:Stock on hand: What do we hold right now, and what is at or below its reorder point?
RP.04:Stock on hand: sum of Product Stock on hand
count of Products at or below Reorder point
per_instance.RP.01:Sales by month: What did we sell, month by month?
per_instance.RP.01:Open orders: What is confirmed but not yet fulfilled, on both sides?
RP.04:Open orders: count of Sales orders in Confirmed
count of Purchase orders in Confirmed
per_instance.RP.05:Sales by month:sales value: sum of (Quantity x Unit price) over Sales order lines whose Sales order reached Shipped in the month, attributed to the date it reached Shipped
per_instance.P.01:Operations: Oversees the whole flow; approves purchases and closes orders.
per_instance.P.01:Sales: Takes customer orders and manages customer accounts.

features.rule: remove Purchase order, Purchase order line, Supplier and the PO workflow -> sales-only inventory app
empty the approvals list -> Draft->Confirmed needs no sign-off
remove Reorder point field and the Low stock alert together
small shops merge Sales/Purchasing/Warehouse into Operations; P.00 = yes lets one person hold several
delete rights stay 'Operations only' to keep the adjustment trail honest — widen deliberately or not at all
